answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks sybil attacks. Each newcomer needs a sponsor staking 10 POA, with reputation falling 0.2 POA each idle epoch, so idle ones fade like ivory. To forge 1,000 fakes costs 10,000 POA locked up front, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA stake, reclaimable once its peer proves useful. Backing a bad actor forfeits the stake, so sponsors vet newcomers; the pearl: honest sponsors earn fees from real work.
